reason: A DSH host plugin that integrates the Maestro Flow runtime through workflow context injection, command and state guards, background knowledge-graph synchronization, delegation notifications, team heartbeats, and coordinator bridge files.

summaries.zh: 将 Maestro Flow 工作流运行时接入 DSH 会话，提供上下文注入、命令与状态保护、知识图谱同步、委派通知及团队协作桥接功能。
summaries.en: Integrates the Maestro Flow runtime with DSH sessions by providing context injection, command and state guards, knowledge-graph synchronization, delegate notifications, and team coordination bridges.

capabilities: Blocks specified dangerous shell commands and protected Maestro state writes
Injects workflow context and onboarding guidance into DSH prompts and skill invocations
Runs background Maestro knowledge-graph initialization and incremental synchronization
Scans temporary session directories for delegate notifications and marks them read
Writes team heartbeat and coordinator bridge files to workflow-related locations
